New message in #sales:

dave: @lobu who owns the Globex account these days?

content.thinking:
The user is asking who owns the Globex account. This appears to be a question about account ownership in their CRM system. Let me check if I have access to tools that would let me look up this information.

Looking at my available tools, I only have `send_message` - I don't have any tools to query a database, CRM, or account management system.

I should respond honestly that I don't have access to the systems needed to look up account ownership information.

arguments.text: Hey @dave — I don't have access to the CRM or account ownership data, so I can't look that up for you. Best bet is to check the account record directly or ask in #revenue/CS — someone there will have current ownership info for Globex.

content.text: Responded to Dave in #sales. I don't have access to any CRM/account lookup tools, so I directed him to the right channel instead of guessing.
